description: Large trades on the venues, newest first, reaching back 30 days. Answers "what are whales buying". Each row names the market (with its ref), the side, price, dollars and, where the venue names traders, the trader with their record. Every row older than an hour counts toward the account's 5,000 trades a day; rows from the last hour are free. With exactly one trader: since can reach back 90 days, and include small adds that trader's smaller trades too (newest first only); either counts the trader toward the account's 100 traders a day.

category.description: Market categories to include. Omit for all.

day.description: Only markets whose game is played today, tomorrow or this week (US Eastern). Season-long markets have no day and are left out.

include.description: small: the one trader named, their trades below whale size too. Needs exactly one trader.

kind.description: Kinds of market, e.g. nba, nfl, soccer, fed_rates. Omit for all.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.

market.description: Market refs, from search_markets or a trade row.

minWinRate.description: Only traders who won at least this share of settled bets, 0 to 1.

named.description: Only trades whose trader is named.

outcome.description: A side by its name ("Yes", "Lakers", "Up"). Needs exactly one market.

since.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, e.g. 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z. Trades reach back 30 days.

trader.description: Trader refs (venue:id), from search_traders or a trade row.

venue.description: Venues to include. Omit for all.

name: get_trades

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next page. Null on the last page.

title: Whale trades
